purpose: Engineering wake comparison alongside matched PyTorch/OpenFOAM single-phase CFD; not full tunnel reproduction

baseline.coordinate_convention: x east, y north; meteorological wind from west gives +x flow

models.name: Jensen_1983
models.parameter_status: declared diagnostic choice, not paper value

experiments.purpose: Compare engineering wake shape and recovery with CFD; near-wake annular double peak not expected to be reproduced
Separate assumed wake expansion from CFD discrepancy; all results reported, no selection by reference error
Test loading trends and flag high-Ct/near-wake model limitations; existing CFD reference only at Ct .95

experiments.superposition: SquaredSum, explicit for both model families
experiments.rotor_averaging: area quadrature with convergence check; report rotor average separately from hub-point wind
experiments.purpose: Compare downstream rotor effective wind speed; layouts are new experiments, not paper cases

metrics: profile RMSE on common uniformly spaced y/R grid
wake deficit integral over common sampled width
downstream rotor averaged effective speed for P4

reference.warning: OpenFOAM is an unvalidated numerical reference, not ground truth; record provenance and sampling differences

limitations: UniformSite does not reproduce wind-tunnel bottom no-slip boundary, wall-generated shear, finite tunnel boundaries or terrain.
Engineering wake models do not resolve annular force-region geometry or central hole.
Ct is specified against reference wind; CFD induction-based local-disc loading must be audited separately.
No physical power curve is available. Do not report electrical power, AEP, or T*U as generation. If an API placeholder power function is required, tag it nonphysical and discard power outputs.
Fixed-k models do not constitute ambient-TI sensitivity models; keep ambient TI fixed in this matrix.
No 23-turbine terrain comparison until inflow, rotor curves and terrain assumptions are explicitly matched.
execution_requirements: Install PyWake in isolated environment and pin exact installed version.
Verify literature model APIs, explicit Ct-to-induction choice and high-Ct behavior in that version.
Smoke test downstream direction, zero-Ct recovery, finite outputs and rotor quadrature convergence.
Store configs, source snapshot, version, profiles and limitations under protocol v1.1 before retaining runs.
